description.en: Ethics-application checklist for DeepSeek Harness: an 18-item keyword checklist, an advisory risk level with required safeguards, and JSON/Markdown output with REP evidence. A checklist aid, not an ethics-committee decision.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的伦理申请清单：18 项关键词清单、基于结构化标记的建议风险等级与必要保障，输出 JSON/Markdown 与 REP 证据。清单辅助，不替代伦理委员会决定。
